race.comment: HELLO DOLLY DIVA (7) is long overdue for a maiden win placing 5/6 runs, including 2/2 when fresh. Expected to go close. KAIDA ODORI (8) has raced twice. Was second on debut then clocked in 2.5 lengths from the winner in sixth last time out over 1200m at Sunshine Coast. That run was better than it looked after an awkward start. Drawn for a nice run just off the speed. Well placed and should run well. . NASIRON (3) finished second last time over 1100m here, beaten one length. Fitter and extra trip a plus. Ready to go one better. REIGN OF DAME (9) put together three minors here on end before finishing seventh on the Gold Coast. Can bounce back.
